title: Patch: drop the at-a-glance Token and Created marks, keep them in the hover preview
notes: A card's Token and Created status rarely matters in combat, so no face wears the token mark (R1177001) or the Created pill (R943) any more; the hover preview still says both, a token's full face on its type line and a Created card in its state notes (R2647000). The wire and the views are unchanged. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Cleaner card faces
changes: Cards no longer wear a Token or Created mark on the board, in hand or in the backrow. Hover over a card, or hold it on a touch screen, to see either.
